# mtncloud_environment (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud environment data source: looks up an environment (such as Production) by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_environment" "production" {
  name = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the MTN Cloud environment

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the environment is active
- `code` (String) Optional code for use with policies
- `description` (String) The description of the MTN Cloud environment
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `visibility` (String) Whether the environment is visible in sub-tenants or not
